extension.summary: Recommended viewing distance, TV size and mount height for your room
extension.description: Enter your TV screen size (diagonal) and get the recommended seating distance for a 30 degree viewing angle (SMPTE) and a 40 degree viewing angle (THX), the screen width and height of a 16:9 TV, and a suggested mount height so the centre of the screen is near seated eye level. You can also enter your seating distance to get the TV size range that fits it. All values are in inches and centimetres. Results are typical guidelines, not a substitute for the TV maker's instructions.
extension.disclaimer: Guideline values only. Check the TV and mount manuals and anchor the mount into studs or masonry.
